title: Career roadmap · R&D Head
summary: Build from advanced research expertise into research-programme leadership, with responsibility for technology strategy, teams, intellectual property, partnerships, budgets and commercialisation.

facts.Current degree: D.Sc / D.Litt / DBA / Post-Doctoral & Industry-Sponsored Doctorates
facts.Timeline assumption: The supplied qualification is already at doctoral/post-doctoral level. For an R&D Head pathway, academic credentials are only one part of the profile: the decisive progression is from specialist research → project leadership → portfolio management → R&D strategy. The underlying discipline also matters; a D.Sc/engineering doctorate may map directly into technical R&D, while a D.Litt or DBA is more naturally aligned with research strategy, management, innovation or organisational R&D.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Lead research projects, build industry collaborations, publish/patent where appropriate and demonstrate delivery of measurable R&D outcomes.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Own a technology or research domain and move into programme-management responsibility.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Manage multiple R&D teams/projects, budgets, external partnerships, IP portfolios and technology-transfer activities.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Set enterprise-level research and technology strategy, allocate R&D investment and build a sustained innovation pipeline.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: The transition from researcher to R&D head requires business literacy without abandoning scientific discipline. Learn to decide which projects deserve investment, when to stop weak projects, how to protect IP and how to move promising research toward deployment.

At this level, conventional internships are usually not the right target. Look for research projects, industry-sponsored programmes, R&D management roles, technology-transfer assignments and visiting research positions.

blocks.text: Ph.D./advanced research routes
Because the student already has an advanced doctorate:

The target at this stage is enterprise-level research leadership. An R&D Head should be able to translate corporate strategy into a research portfolio, allocate people and capital across projects, manage technical and commercial risk, protect and exploit IP, develop external partnerships and build the next generation of research leaders. The doctorate establishes research credibility; sustained delivery and organisational leadership establish R&D-head readiness.
